p2-first-serve-pitch.reason: Actual AUD3PER is 1687 for captured SN76489A tone divisor 213. The nearest integral Paula period is 1688 using the stock PAL 3546895 Hz clock and four-sample waveform. Native conversion uses 507/64=7.921875 instead of 3546895*8/3579545=7.927029832. Captured native WAV is consistent with the written period; source state and PSG bytes match. No waveform tolerance is inferred and no product correction is applied.

p2-first-serve-envelope.reason: At serve attenuation 14, the recorded source plateau amplitude is 326 relative to 8191 at full volume, stable under 2/3/4 ms trims. Its nearest 0-64 Paula level is 3; the native table writes 2. The other 14 measured decay levels agree. Source state and PSG sequence match; pitch is compared separately. No product fix is applied.
